regions.name: Andean Region
visual_identifiers: coffee plantation rows on steep hillsides

state_distinguishers.Bogota_area: High altitude 2600m city, TransMilenio red BRT buses distinctive, very specific Bogota urban infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Medellin_area: Valley city surrounded by mountains, Metro cable cars visible, specific Medellin urban feel
state_distinguishers.Coffee_region: Coffee plantation rows, bamboo guadua forests, colorful Jeep Willys as taxis

regions.route_sign_clues: Ruta Nacional prefix. Transversal and Troncal highway names.
regions.gemini_hint: Red TransMilenio BRT buses = Bogota. Cable cars on mountain = Medellin. Colorful Jeep Willys taxis = Coffee Region. Coffee rows on steep hills = Antioquia or Coffee Region.
common_false_positives: Andean terrain — shared with Ecuador and Peru

regions.name: Caribbean Coast
visual_identifiers: dry tropical vegetation in La Guajira
Wayuu indigenous culture in La Guajira

state_distinguishers.Cartagena_area: Walled colonial city architecture, Caribbean resort infrastructure
state_distinguishers.La_Guajira: Extremely arid desert peninsula, Wayuu indigenous settlements, flamingo lagoons

regions.gemini_hint: Colonial walled city = Cartagena. Extreme desert + indigenous settlements = La Guajira. Flat tropical coast = Colombian Caribbean.
common_false_positives: Caribbean coast — could be Venezuela coast

regions.name: Pacific Coast and Amazon
visual_identifiers: extremely wet tropical rainforest in Choco
specific Afro-Colombian cultural elements in Choco

state_distinguishers.Choco: Wettest place in world, Afro-Colombian culture, very limited road infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Amazonas: Amazon river, Leticia city on Amazon, indigenous Amazon culture

regions.route_sign_clues: Very limited roads in these regions.
regions.gemini_hint: Extremely dense wet jungle with no roads = Choco or Amazon Colombia. Amazon river infrastructure = Leticia/Amazonas.
common_false_positives: Amazon jungle — shared with Brazil, Peru, Ecuador

regions.name: Llanos and Eastern Plains

state_distinguishers.Meta: Villavicencio city, gateway to llanos, more developed than other llanos

regions.gemini_hint: Flat treeless grassland + oil infrastructure = Casanare llanos. Gateway city to plains = Villavicencio/Meta.
common_false_positives: Flat grassland llanos — also in Venezuela
